name: Calculator
description: Natural-language calculator: math, unit and currency conversion, percentages and tips, dates ("days until christmas"), world clocks ("5pm ldn in sf"), number bases, ratios, and color conversions — right in the search bar.

preferences.name: preferredCurrency
preferences.title: Preferred currency
preferences.description: 3-letter code (e.g. USD, EUR, IQD) used when you type an amount like "50 usd" without a target currency.

walkthrough.title: A calculator you never have to open
walkthrough.summary: Type a calculation straight into the search bar
walkthrough.body:
Type a sum, a unit conversion, a currency conversion, or a date difference straight into the search bar and the answer appears as you type. No app to open, no mode to switch into.

Try these:

- `1234 * 56`
- `120 usd in eur`
- `18% of 240`
- `days until dec 25`

## To complete the task

Do one calculation in the search bar, then mark this task complete.
